name: Retro Video Store Simulator
summary:
Retro Video Store Simulator 📼🏪🕹️

Step into the golden age of physical media with Retro Video Store Simulator, an immersive video game store simulator in virtual reality where nostalgia meets management gameplay. Run your very own retro shop, stock shelves with classic retro VHS, DVDs, and video games, and build the ultimate destination for collectors and movie lovers alike.
